declared_before: Complete full-matrix and generation summaries; no secondary timing comparisons examined for selection.
full_scope: All ten nonprimary prefill/decode workloads in the frozen matrix; four primary workloads retain completed fixed confirmations.
trigger: Any negative baseline-minus-candidate offload or folded resident mean in the original single paired block. Zero differences do not trigger.
followup: Keep original pair and add exactly two independent balanced pairs for both placements using extend_pairs.py. Estimate and persist exact work before launch.
verdict: Use original95% Student-t rule over three independent blocks; any resolved offload regression/resident slowdown or memory loss fails. If uncertainty remains, report it; do not extend until favorable.
failure_handling: OOM/unsupported/missing original rows require review, never substitute zeros.
source_scope: Frozen A0000 versus candidate for full/generation; incremental A0001 primary gate already passed independently.
